later_events.mechanism: amendment by word substitution, recorded as an event and not an end: section 2-101 of EO 12107 (signed 1978-12-28; 44 FR 1055, Federal Register of January 3, 1979) amends each listed order by substituting the words Office of Personnel Management for Civil Service Commission and the words Director, Office of Personnel Management for Chairman, Civil Service Commission, and EO 11355 is listed in subsection 2-101(b); section 2-404 says "Order, this Order shall be effective on January 1, 1979." Before: clause 1 makes the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission responsible for the annual survey. After: the Director of the Office of Personnel Management carries that duty; the exact post-substitution wording is not printed in the held sources. The substitution does not touch clauses 2 and 3, which name no Commission or Chairman.

clauses.mechanism: express revocation by EO 12919 (signed 1994-06-03; 59 FR 29525, printed June 7, 1994; held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12919.txt), section 904(a), provides that "The following are superseded or revoked:" and lists, as item (6), "Executive Order No. 11355 of May 26, 1967 (32 FR 7803)." and, as item (4), EO 10647, the order this one amends. EO 12919 contains no effective-date wording (the word effective appears only in descriptive phrases), so the revocation is read as taking effect on signing, 1994-06-03; that is an inference from the heading and signature block, not express wording.
clauses.reason: Clause 1 rewrites the first sentence of subsection 305(a) of EO 10647 so that at least once every twelve months the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission surveys appointments made under section 710(b)(1) of the Act. It continued, amended, until the order ended: first end EO 12919, 1994-06-03, which supersedes or revokes EO 11355 by number in section 904(a)(6) and EO 10647 in section 904(a)(4). Later event, not an end: EO 12107, effective 1979-01-01, substitutes Office of Personnel Management words for Civil Service Commission words in the orders listed in its section 2-101(b), which include EO 11355. Before: the survey duty lies with the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission. After: the substitution rule replaces Civil Service Commission with Office of Personnel Management and the Chairman with the Director of that Office, so the duty lies with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management; the held sources print no consolidated text of the sentence after substitution.

clauses.reason: Clause 3 revokes Part II of EO 10647. The revocation took effect with the order on 1967-05-26; its consequence (Part II of EO 10647 stays revoked) is an accrued result. As a provision of this order the clause stayed on the books until the order was revoked: first end EO 12919, 1994-06-03, section 904(a)(6). Revoking this clause did not revive Part II, because EO 10647 was itself revoked by the same section. The alternative reading, that the clause was exhausted by performance on 1967-05-26, does not change the whole-order end date.

research_rationale:
EO 11355 (signed 1967-05-26; 32 FR 7803, Federal Register of May 30, 1967) amends EO 10647 of November 28, 1955 on appointments under the Defense Production Act of 1950: clause 1 rewrites the first sentence of subsection 305(a) (at least once every twelve months the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission surveys appointments made under section 710(b)(1) of the Act), clause 2 rewrites paragraph (1) of subsection 305(b) (the statistical report of appointments) and clause 3 revokes Part II of EO 10647. I read the full held Federal Register text (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11355.txt, PDF page 7) and confirmed its number, title, page and date against the census register; the three numbered clauses are the complete inventory, and the opening authority paragraph is a lead-in, not a command. EO 12919 (signed 1994-06-03) supersedes or revokes EO 11355 by number in section 904(a)(6), and EO 10647 in section 904(a)(4); that express revocation is the first end of every clause. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments each amending clause continues, amended, until the parent order ends. EO 12107 (signed 1978-12-28, effective 1979-01-01) lists EO 11355 in its section 2-101(b) and substitutes Office of Personnel Management words for Civil Service Commission words; it is recorded as a later event of clause 1, not an end. Bounded search: the dossier's three machine searches, chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no coverage warning (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts); the Cruden by-number scan of held order texts in the packet's LOOKUPS.md; a full read of EO 12919 (held FR text) and of sections 2-101 and 2-404 of EO 12107 (held FR text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12107.txt).

savings.reason: EO 12919 section 903 keeps previously issued orders and actions in effect only "except as they are inconsistent with this order" or are revoked, and section 904(a) revokes this order by name, so its commands do not continue. Section 903 also provides that nothing "in this order shall affect the validity or force of anything done under previous" delegations or other assignment of authority under the Act; surveys, reports and appointments made under EO 10647 as amended by this order are therefore accrued completed acts.
